Field.Label: Fabric label:
Field.Description: How this Indigo controller is named on your Matter devices — it's what other ecosystems' apps show in their "connected services" / admin lists. Applied on every connect; renames existing devices too. Max 32 characters; blank resets to Indigo.

Field.Label: Node bin directory (optional):
Field.Description: Directory containing node/npx. Leave blank to auto-detect (Homebrew, then nvm, then PATH). nvm users can pin a version here, e.g. ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.18.0/bin; Homebrew users normally leave it blank. Only used when the LaunchAgent is managed automatically.

Field.Label: Manage matter-server LaunchAgent automatically:
Field.Description: When off, the plugin connects to a matter-server you start yourself (recommended during development). When on, the plugin installs and supervises a launchd LaunchAgent (process-management approach PM-B).

Field.Label: Primary network interface (for managed LaunchAgent):
Field.Description: macOS interface matter-server binds to (e.g. en0). Only used when the LaunchAgent is managed automatically.

Field.Label: matter-server listen address (for managed LaunchAgent):
Field.Description: IP address the managed matter-server binds its WebSocket control API to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 (loopback) — STRONGLY recommended. The control API is UNAUTHENTICATED, so binding it to 0.0.0.0 or a LAN address exposes full Matter fabric control to anyone on your network; only change this if matter-server runs on a different host and you have a trusted firewall in front of it. (Distinct from "matter-server host" above, which is the client connect target.) Blank falls back to 127.0.0.1. Only used when the LaunchAgent is managed automatically.
